id.description: The name identifier of the animation clip.

sample_rate.description: The frame rate / sample rate of the animation clip (maps to clip.frameRate).

curves.description: (Advanced) Array of animated property tracks targeting specific hierarchy paths and components.

frames.description: Array of sprite frames (Only for non layered card art).

path.description: Relative hierarchy path to the target GameObject (e.g., 'CardEffectTransforms/Spike', 'CardSprite').

type.description: The component type hosting the property being animated.

attribute.description: The property name on the Component type to animate (e.g., 'position.x', 'scale.x', 'layer4.enabled').

keyframes.description: (Advanced) List of keyframe points defining the curve.

time.description: Timestamp in seconds along the animation timeline.

value.description: Evaluated float value at this timestamp.

in_slope.description: Incoming tangent slope (numeric float or string representation for Infinity/-Infinity).

out_slope.description: Outgoing tangent slope (numeric float or string representation for Infinity/-Infinity).
